scripts.setup: pnpm install && composer install && pnpm run build
scripts.build:production: pnpm install && composer install --no-dev && pnpm run build
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm run build:production && bash dev-scripts/deploy.sh staging
scripts.deploy:staging:dry: pnpm run build:production && bash dev-scripts/deploy.sh staging --dry-run
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run build:production && bash dev-scripts/deploy.sh production
scripts.deploy:production:dry: pnpm run build:production && bash dev-scripts/deploy.sh production --dry-run
scripts.fix: pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run fix:php
